policy: All Markdown links and filename tokens in Markdown prose/tables, plus every JSON log/inventory string. Code fences and API calls are not prose citations. Bare TypeScript source names may resolve from explicit prose context or a unique repository suffix/basename. Artifact names are never rescued through an unrelated same-named file elsewhere; relative links must resolve at their stated location. pnpm.cmd is recorded as an installed command reference.
